title: Transcription accuracy on a 47s two-voice recording (word error rate)
hypothesis: Gemini transcribes clear speech with WER under 10%.

utterances.speaker: spk:0
utterances.text: Welcome back. Last week you said your sleep was getting worse. How has it been?

utterances.speaker: spk:1
utterances.text: A little better. I stopped drinking coffee after two in the afternoon and I fell asleep before midnight four nights this week.

utterances.speaker: spk:0
utterances.text: That is a real change. What happened on the other three nights?

utterances.speaker: spk:1
utterances.text: I was worrying about the budget meeting on Thursday. I kept replaying what my boss might say.

utterances.speaker: spk:0
utterances.text: Let's try scheduling a worry period. 15 minutes at 7:00 in the evening written down in a notebook.

utterances.speaker: spk:1
utterances.text: Okay. I can do that after dinner.

utterances.speaker: spk:0
utterances.text: Good. We will review the notebook together next Tuesday.
